items.text: Adults 21 and over (visitors included) may possess up to 2.5 ounces of cannabis, of which no more than 15 g concentrate. Public consumption is banned, property owners can prohibit use, and cannabis can't be taken across state lines.

layers.authority: US National Park Service, Isle Royale National Park
layers.process: Isle Royale is reached by ferry or seaplane (park season 16 April to 31 October). Daily entrance fee US$7 per person aged 16 and over (about A$9.90) for each calendar day in the park; it is cashless. Every overnight party of 1 to 6 people needs a small-party permit: no extra fee, issued free by a ranger on the ferry or on arrival (seaplane arrivals self-permit), and campsites are first come, first served. Groups of 7 or more need a group camping permit with advance reservation. Display the permit on the pack or tent and return it before leaving the island. The US$60 Season Pass is for US citizens or residents. Fees in US dollars; A$1 = USD 0.7040 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026), so US$1 is about A$1.42.
